exposure: previous vaginal delivery vs. no previous vaginal delivery
outcome: vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) success rate
cohort: 567 women with one previous lower segment cesarean delivery admitted for trial of labor
finding: Women with one previous cesarean section who undergo induction of labor (IOL) have lower VBAC success rates and a higher risk of cesarean delivery due to fetal distress compared to those with spontaneous labor onset.
mod_finding: Women with one previous cesarean section who undergo induction of labor have lower rates of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) compared with those who presented in spontaneous labor.
